title: Testing four unknown metals in salt solutions
body: A student was given clean strips of four metals labelled W, X, Y and Z. She placed a strip of each metal separately in test tubes containing iron(II) sulphate, copper(II) sulphate, zinc sulphate and silver nitrate solutions and observed them after 30 minutes. Metal W displaced the metal from all four solutions. Metal X displaced copper from copper(II) sulphate and silver from silver nitrate, but showed no reaction with iron(II) sulphate or zinc sulphate. Metal Y displaced silver from silver nitrate only. Metal Z showed no reaction with any of the four solutions.

title: Investigating the rusting of iron nails
body: Riya placed a clean iron nail in each of three test tubes. In tube P she poured some tap water and corked the tube, leaving air above the water. In tube Q she poured boiled distilled water, added about 1 mL of oil on top and corked it. In tube R she put some anhydrous calcium chloride and corked it. She left the three tubes undisturbed for four days and then examined the nails for a brown, flaky coating.
